name: Newsletter
summary: The site's newsletter: sign-ups confirmed by email, emails sent with one-click unsubscribe, bounces set aside.
use_when: People should be able to ask for the site's news and new releases by email, from a form on any page
The site's people write an email, test it on themselves, and send it now or at a set time to everyone who asked
A new blog post should go to the subscribers as soon as it's live
The site sends its own mail by SMTP or Resend and must keep its list clean of addresses that bounce or complain
avoid_when: Mail should be segmented, A/B tested or tracked by opens and clicks: that's a marketing platform's job
A person should hear about something they did, such as a reply to their comment: that's the kernel's notifications
Members talk to each other or to staff: that's a chat or community module

permissions.description: Write, test, schedule and send the newsletter's emails, and see its counts
See the newsletter's subscribers and the addresses set aside, set one aside and remove one

settings.description: Whether the newsletter takes sign-ups; while it's off, the forms say sign-ups are closed
The postal address every newsletter carries (US law; a P.O. box will do). Nothing sends until it's set

settings.default: You're getting this because you asked for news from ${site_name}.
settings.description: The footer's first line; ${site_name} is the site's name
How many newsletter copies may go out in an hour, 1 to 10,000: a sixtieth each minute. 400 by default, under a Spacemail mailbox's 500 with room for the site's own mail

env.name: CAMPAIGNS_BOUNCE_IMAP_HOST
env.description: The bounce mailbox's IMAP host, such as mail.example.com or mail.example.com:993; with the next two, bounces are read every 15 minutes

env.name: CAMPAIGNS_BOUNCE_IMAP_USERNAME
env.description: The bounce mailbox's login: on Spacemail and most mailbox hosts, the sending mailbox itself

env.name: CAMPAIGNS_BOUNCE_IMAP_PASSWORD
env.description: The bounce mailbox's password, typed into the host's variables by the owner

env.name: CAMPAIGNS_BOUNCE_IMAP_FOLDER
env.description: The folder a read report moves to; Newsletter bounces by default

env.name: CAMPAIGNS_RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: Only for a site that sends by Resend: the webhook's signing secret (whsec_...), for its bounces and complaints
